subject: Pilot wrap: metrics recap & quick reference ask
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@skyfin.com>, Jared Mills <jared.mills@skyfin.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot wrap & metrics recap

Hi Emily / Jared,

Thanks again for partnering with us on the three-week inference pilot. Quick recap of the high-level outcomes we saw during the evaluation window:

- Latency: 45% median latency reduction on the production-like workload (p95 improved from 420ms → 230ms).
- Throughput: sustained 3x throughput increase using Redwood batching + KV cache vs your baseline.
- Cost efficiency: estimated per-request cost reduction of ~27% after enabling prefix caching and optimized kernels.
- Reliability: error rate dropped to <0.5% (from ~2.1%) after edge-case model routing.

Attached is a two-page metrics summary (skyfin_metrics_summary.pdf) and a short proposed agenda for a 15-minute customer quote call (proposed-quote-call-agenda.md).

If you're comfortable, we'd love to do two things:
1) Use SkyFin Analytics as a short customer reference / quote for a one-paragraph case highlight and a one-sentence quote we can use on our site.
2) Schedule a very quick 15-minute call (recording optional) where we can capture a 2–3 line testimonial and confirm the numbers we can publish.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue Jun 9, 09:00–09:15
- Tue Jun 9, 13:30–13:45
- Wed Jun 10, 11:00–11:15

If you prefer to provide a short quote by email or want to review/edit the wording before we publish, that's totally fine — we can send a draft.

Thanks, and congrats to the SkyFin team — the integration looked clean and the infra changes were minimal.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0197

Attachments:
- skyfin_metrics_summary.pdf (2 pages, metrics tables + charts)
- proposed-quote-call-agenda.md (1 page)
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@skyfin.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 06 Jun 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap & metrics recap

Marcus —

Thanks for the clear summary and for the work from your side — the improvements are impressive and the SkyFin team is happy with the results. We have a couple of quick asks before publicly agreeing to a quote:

- Can you change the 27% wording to "~25–30% estimated cost improvement" — legal wants ranges for public statements.
- Please anonymize any internal transaction IDs in charts (we can point those out).

We’re okay to be a reference, but we’d like to review the final one-paragraph blurb before it goes on your site. Happy to do a short call — I can do Tue Jun 9 at 13:30 PST. Jared will join as well.

Thanks,
Emily
Director of ML Ops | SkyFin Analytics
emily.carter@skyfin.com | (206) 555-0123
